abilities.name: Reckless
abilities.description: Once per round, you may spend 6 Hope. If you do, your partner Digimon acts first in the round, before anyone else takes their turn. When your Digimon attacks this round, they gain 1d4 to their hit roll. Any enemy that attacks your Digimon this round gains that same 1d4 bonus to their hit roll as well.

abilities.name: Full Throttle
abilities.description: Reckless's bonus die increases from 1d4 to 1d8. Enemies attacking your Digimon this round only gain half of that rolled bonus, rounded down, instead of the full amount.

abilities.name: Cutting Corners
abilities.description: Reckless now costs 3 Hope instead of 6.

abilities.name: Brace for Impact
abilities.description: Once per round, declared before your attack roll: if your Digimon is targeted by an attack this round, your Digimon's attack gains 1d8 to its damage, and the damage you take from that attack is reduced by 1d12, down to as low as 0.

abilities.name: No Brakes
abilities.description: Reckless's bonus die now applies to your damage rolls as well as your hit rolls. If your attack misses, enemies do not gain the bonus from Reckless this round.

abilities.name: Overtime
abilities.description: Whenever your Digimon undergoes a timed digivolution, such as a DNA Digivolution or an Item Digivolution, that digivolution lasts 2 additional rounds beyond its normal duration.
